name: Public Render Studio defaults
description: Shipped with the public repo. Auto update publishing is ON for docs only. Local servers copy this once into data/server-config/ and then own their settings.

instructions.docs: Writes to frontend/docs/updates/shipped.json and syncs milestones. Always safe for the public repo.
instructions.slack: Set SLACK_UPDATES_WEBHOOK_URL in the environment (Incoming Webhook). Enable the Slack toggle here. Secrets stay out of git.
instructions.discord: Configure DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN + DISCORD_UPDATES_CHANNEL_ID or DISCORD_UPDATES_WEBHOOK_URL, then enable Discord here.
instructions.linkedin: Configure LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN + LINKEDIN_AUTHOR_URN, then enable LinkedIn here.
